Package io.telekom.orchest.telemetry.metrics

Interface MetricsRepository

public interface MetricsRepository
Persistence SPI for the metrics pipeline.

Implementations must be safe to call concurrently from multiple pods. The lifetime-totals write path is expected to use atomic per-document upserts (e.g. MongoDB's $inc) so that concurrent flushes from N pods aggregate correctly without coordination.

The time-bucket write path is bucketed at the storage granularity returned by storageGranularity(); coarser granularities are produced by summation in the controller layer.

  • Method Details

    • storageGranularity

      default MetricGranularity storageGranularity()
      Storage-side granularity used for time-bucket persistence (typically MINUTE).

    • applyIncrements

      void applyIncrements(Collection<MetricIncrement> increments)
      Atomically applies all increments to both the lifetime-totals and the time-bucket collections. Implementations should use a single batched / bulk operation per collection to minimise database round-trips.

    • findLifetimeTotals

      List<MetricLifetimeTotal> findLifetimeTotals(MetricType type, String definitionId)
      Returns lifetime totals for streams matching the optional filters. null means "any" for that filter, e.g. findLifetimeTotals(null, null) returns every total.

    • findLifetimeTotal

      Optional<MetricLifetimeTotal> findLifetimeTotal(MetricKey key)
      Returns the lifetime total for an exact MetricKey if it exists.

    • findTimeBuckets

      List<MetricTimeBucket> findTimeBuckets(MetricType type, String definitionId, Instant from, Instant to)
      Returns minute-granularity time buckets matching type (required) and definitionId (optional, null = "any") with from <= bucketStart < to.
